_site.aboutBody:
## Is this the official leaderboard for Final Fantasy speedruns?
Yes, it is (at least for the games listed here).
The goal of this leaderboard is to provide the most objective and fair environment possible. I utilize "future-proof" rules designed to remain consistent, regardless of who is moderating.

In other communities, runners often face arbitrary changes, such as merging turbo and non-turbo runs, re-voting on skips that were previously established, or clinging to illogical timing methods for the sake of "legacy." This leaderboard avoids those pitfalls, offering a stable and just platform where every runner is treated with objectivity.

## How is the leaderboard organized?
I implement a cutoff time to appear on the ranked leaderboard. This ensures that the rankings reflect serious attempts at competitive improvement. However, anyone can submit their time, and those who do not meet the cutoff will still appear on the site as "unranked".

## Why do you use the term "timed segment" instead of "when the run starts"?
In speedrunning, it is often assumed that a "run" only exists while the timer is running. For example, many RPGs are timed from selecting "New Game" until the final hit on the last boss.
However, timing points are subjective; they are simply the segments the community has agreed to compare. In many Final Fantasy games, RNG   can be manipulated before "New Game" is even pressed. I distinguish between two specific concepts:
a) The Run: Defines what is allowed from the moment the game is booted.
b) The Timed Segment: Defines the portion of the run that is actually compared on the clock.

By separating these, we can keep familiar timing methods (like New Game to Final Hit) while still forbidding unfair pre-game manipulations (like loading specific saves or external RNG setups). This ensures a fair competition without pretending that the "New Game" screen is a perfectly objective boundary.

## Why is a specific game or category not listed?
If you are interested in seeing a specific game or category added to the site, please feel free to contact me.
